name: inspect_native_instruction
description: Inspect one exact code or data address: decoded bytes, mnemonic, ordered operand tokens, flow, outgoing instruction references and typed incoming references where available. For a byte inside a listed instruction or defined data, Ghidra reports the containing instruction or data object separately, preserving the query and address space. Inspect the starting address of a data object with inspect_native_data_type for its layout; a containing object does not select a field or union member. Incoming references preserve source, access kind, operand index and analysis provenance even at data addresses; they do not prove runtime access. Page retained references with inspect_analysis_view kind native-instruction-references; null coverage means the selected collection was unavailable or not recorded. Memory addressing decomposition is unavailable when the provider supplies only tokens. Ghidra reports in-memory addresses without a listed instruction or defined data as not-in-listing, without attempting a decode.
